name: GDLM 68 camera lab
desc: Fly up and down! Flying portals low, middle and high, open sky and corridors: how GD's camera moves. Record it.

accept.dead air: lab level: watch-only stations and labels, no gameplay to fill (tools/deadair.js)

lab.name: cube: climb 10, stay, drop
lab.note: starts at 2.1 s. cube camera: climb 10 blocks (jump each step), walk 2+ s on top (above the 5.5-block screen cap: how far up does the camera go?), walk off: a 10-block drop (how fast it comes back down). Hexagon Force's fit: +0.38 block per block above 2, cap 5.5; easing 9.75/s ASSUMED

lab.name: cube: red pad launch
lab.note: starts at 9.8 s. a red pad throws the cube up fast (sim apex in --check): the camera while moving fast. Then 3 s of flat ground

lab.name: cube upside down on a ceiling
lab.note: starts at 14.1 s. a gravity portal flips the cube onto a ceiling (row 6) for 3+ s, then back: does the camera follow the flip the same way?

lab.name: speeds 0.5x 1x 2x 3x
lab.note: starts at 18.9 s. flat ground, ~3 s at each speed (0.5x, 1x, 2x, 3x), a short pole every 5 blocks: does the player's screen x or the zoom change with speed? Back to 1x at the end

lab.name: ship LOW, then ship HIGH 1 s later
lab.note: starts at 31.8 s. ship portal on the floor (row 1: sim band 0-300): fly 3 s; then fly UP into the second ship portal (row 9, y 285: sim band 120-420) and stay 3 s. Two band changes ~1 s apart: restart or blend?

lab.name: ship HIGH from a tower
lab.note: starts at 41.2 s. ship portal on a 6-block tower (row 8, y 255): sim band 90-390: the band starts 3 blocks up. Fly to both edges, 3+ s

lab.name: ship from a pad (rising), corridor
lab.note: starts at 47.4 s. a yellow pad throws you up through a ship portal in the air (row 3, y 105: rising entry; sim band 0-300), then a corridor (floor row 2, roof row 8) for 3+ s

lab.name: UFO from a pad (falling)
lab.note: starts at 53.2 s. a yellow pad's arc comes DOWN into a UFO portal (row 2: falling entry; sim band 0-300). Flap up and down 3+ s

lab.name: UFO HIGH from a tower
lab.note: starts at 58.2 s. UFO portal on a 6-block tower (row 9, y 285): sim band 120-420. Flap to the top, let it fall to the bottom

lab.name: swing LOW, then a corridor
lab.note: starts at 64.3 s. swing on the floor (row 1: sim band 0-300): open 3 s, then a corridor (floor row 2, roof row 7) 3 s

lab.name: swing HIGH from a tower
lab.note: starts at 71.7 s. swing portal on a 6-block tower (row 8, y 255): sim band 90-390

lab.name: wave MID (rising), open
lab.note: starts at 77.8 s. a pad throws you up into a wave portal (row 3, rising: sim band 0-300); zigzag the full height for 3+ s

lab.name: wave corridor
lab.note: starts at 82.6 s. wave in a corridor (floor row 3, roof row 7; entered on the floor: sim band 0-300): small zigzags for 3+ s

lab.name: ship VERY HIGH from a tower
lab.note: starts at 87.3 s. ship portal on a 9-block tower (row 11, y 345): sim band 180-480: the whole band is in the air. Fly to both edges, 3+ s
